title: Minimum Vectorial Linearity of 8-Bit Permutation S-Boxes
summary: The lowest known vectorial linearity for an 8-bit permutation S-box is 17; it remains open whether a lower value can be achieved or 17 is minimal.

formal_statement.body: The lowest known vectorial linearity for an 8-bit permutation S-box is 17. The unresolved task is to construct an 8-bit permutation S-box with vectorial linearity less than 17, or to prove that 17 is the minimum possible value for 8-bit permutations.

scope.domain: Construction and optimality of 8-bit permutation S-boxes in symmetric cryptography.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an 8-bit permutation S-box with vectorial linearity less than 17, or prove that 17 is the minimum possible value for 8-bit permutations.

citations.label: Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes

progress.summary: The source reports 17 as the lowest known vectorial linearity for an 8-bit permutation and explicitly presents finding a better S-box or proving minimality as a challenging open problem.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes
